title: The Notebook Doodle of Two People
youtube_title: The Notebook Doodle of Two People | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Zia is just outside the fun, close to a notebook that had room for a second doodle. Yelena changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Zia has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
